title: Parking Access Through Zoning Lots in Residence Districts
previewText: For a zoning lot within a Residence District, which zoning lot fronts upon either 124th or 126th Street and the rear lot line abuts a zoning lot that fronts only on 125th Street, and such zoning lot has been vacant since April 30, 2008, access for parking and loading purposes may be provided through such zoning lot.
